title: Remove Pneumatic Valve From Tipper (LOTO, side panel access, valve cover screws, M8 connector disconnect)
summary: Safely prepare the OptiSweep tipper for pneumatic valve replacement by performing lockout/tagout (LOTO), exposing the valve cover (including removing the station side panel if needed), removing the valve cover fasteners, and disconnecting the valve’s M8 electrical connector.
when_to_use: Use when you are preparing the OptiSweep tipper station for pneumatic valve replacement and need to LOTO the tipper, access the valve cover, remove the valve cover fasteners, and disconnect the valve’s M8 electrical connector.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for diagnosing tipper station faults on HMI/DB/API surfaces; this is a physical prep/removal step set for valve replacement.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform on-site physical LOTO and mechanical/electrical disconnection steps using the specified tools and PPE.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before removing the valve cover and disconnecting the M8 electrical connector (LOTO referenced as “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on page 2).
Wear safety glasses and gloves during the removal/prep work.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical floor / grid access to the tipper
Tools: 2.5-mm hex wrench, 3-mm hex wrench, 5-mm hex wrench, 6-mm hex wrench, 3/8-in. wrench or socket, Loctite®

access_required: Physical floor / grid access to the tipper
system_preconditions: Tipper is ready for LOTO and mechanical access to the station side panel and valve cover
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (referenced on page 2 of the manual)

visual_references.description: Figure 7-9: Pneumatic Valve assembly showing valve cover, four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws, and the M8 electrical connector at the valve edge.

steps.title: Gather required tools and PPE
steps.purpose: Ensure you have the specified tools, PPE, and replacement part before starting LOTO and disassembly.
steps.instruction: On the physical floor, stage the replacement pneumatic valve, PPE (safety glasses and gloves), and the required hex wrenches (2.5-mm, 3-mm, 5-mm, 6-mm), plus a 3/8-in. wrench or socket and Loctite®.
steps.expected_result: You have the specified tools/PPE available to proceed with LOTO, side panel access (if needed), valve cover fastener removal, and M8 connector disconnection.
steps.healthy_condition: All required tools/PPE are present and ready for use before you begin disassembly.
steps.failure_condition: Missing required tools/PPE or inability to proceed without improvising (e.g., wrong wrench size).

actions.label: Stage tools and PPE
actions.exact_action: Gather required tools and PPE: replacement pneumatic valve; safety glasses and gloves; 2.5-mm, 3-mm, 5-mm, and 6-mm hex wrenches; 3/8-in. wrench or socket; Loctite®

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: De-energize and secure the tipper for safe mechanical/electrical work.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the manual’s “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” procedure (referenced on page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out/tagged out prior to removing the valve cover and disconnecting the M8 electrical connector.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed and the tipper is secured before proceeding to side panel/valve cover removal.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely complete LOTO or LOTO cannot be verified as applied before disassembly.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot safely perform LOTO.

steps.title: Remove station side panel for motor/valve access (if necessary)
steps.purpose: Provide access to the valve cover area by removing the station side panel when required.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed (when necessary) to access the motor/valve cover area.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panel removal is complete without forcing fasteners; access to the motor/valve cover area is unobstructed.
steps.failure_condition: Valve cover access cannot be achieved without forcing screws/fasteners, or side panel removal is unsafe.

actions.label: Remove side panel screws
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the valve cover cannot be removed without forcing fasteners.

steps.title: Remove valve cover fasteners (four M4 socket head screws)
steps.purpose: Expose the pneumatic valve by removing the valve cover.
steps.instruction: Remove the four (4) M4 socket head screws holding the valve cover in place.
steps.expected_result: The four (4) M4 socket head screws are removed and the valve cover is no longer secured.
steps.healthy_condition: All four M4 socket head screws are removed cleanly; valve cover is ready to be accessed for the M8 connector disconnect.
steps.failure_condition: Fasteners cannot be removed without forcing, or the valve cover cannot be removed safely.

actions.label: Remove valve cover screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the four (4) M4 socket head screws holding the valve cover in place.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the valve cover cannot be removed without forcing fasteners.

steps.title: Disconnect the M8 electrical connector from the valve edge
steps.purpose: Disconnect electrical connection to the pneumatic valve to complete the removal/prep stage.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the M8 electrical connector from the edge of the valve.
steps.expected_result: The M8 electrical connector is disconnected from the edge of the valve.
steps.healthy_condition: Connector disconnect is achieved without excessive force; no visible wiring/connector damage is observed during disconnect.
steps.failure_condition: M8 connector cannot be disconnected without excessive force, or wiring/connector damage is observed.

actions.label: Disconnect M8 connector
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the M8 electrical connector from the edge of the valve.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the M8 connector cannot be disconnected without excessive force or if wiring/connector damage is observed.

success_criteria: Tipper is locked out/tagged out before disassembly.
Station side panel is removed (when necessary) to access the motor/valve cover area.
Valve cover fasteners are removed: four (4) M4 socket head screws.
M8 electrical connector is disconnected from the edge of the valve.
healthy_conditions: LOTO is applied before any valve cover removal or electrical disconnection.
Side panel removal (if performed) is achieved by removing nine (9) self-tapping securing screws without forcing.
Valve cover removal is possible after removing the four (4) M4 socket head screws.
M8 connector disconnect is achieved without excessive force and without observed wiring/connector damage.
failure_conditions: Valve cover cannot be removed without forcing fasteners.
M8 connector cannot be disconnected without excessive force.
Wiring/connector damage is observed during M8 disconnect.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot safely perform LOTO, stop and escalate.
If the valve cover cannot be removed without forcing fasteners, stop and escalate.
If the M8 connector cannot be disconnected without excessive force or if wiring/connector damage is observed, stop and escalate.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Valve cover and the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws; the M8 electrical connector at the edge of the valve.
